after_cl.checkpoint_selection_note: Every treatment arm uses best.pt, selected on validation Recall@1. The control uses last.pt deliberately: its pairings are permuted, so validation Recall@1 is meaningless by construction and selection on it picked epoch 3 (R@1 0.00567, chance 0.00227) — an almost untrained checkpoint. last.pt matches the treatment on training steps, which is the comparison the control is for.
after_cl.name: image-block adaptation variants and the shuffled-pairing control
after_cl.note: One extraction pass serves every arm. Pairwise contrasts come from scripts/analysis/compare_downstream_arms.py, not from evaluate_downstream_probe.py.

before_cl.name: dinov2-unadapted
before_cl.pooling: uniform mean over the three planes

frozen_tower_null.declared_in_advance: These runs never updated a DINOv2 weight, so their uniform_mean_768 features must be numerically identical to the before_cl arm. That identity is asserted as a correctness check, and any difference in that feature set would be a bug, not a result.
frozen_tower_null.name: frozen-backbone contrastive runs (--image-unfreeze-last 0), one per report policy

bootstrap.limitation: resampling studies is not resampling patients; anonymisation is per study, so patient identity is unverifiable

config.cohort_note: The cohort manifest pinned here defines the study population and the preprocessed images only. The two arms were trained on two manifests whose images and splits are identical; they differ in report text, and the base multilingual manifest additionally retains two studies the translated manifest quarantines. The 56-study gold population resolves identically under both, verified before training.

comparisons.cohort_contrast: after_cl/original-multilingual-seed2026/uniform_mean_768 versus after_cl/translated-english-seed2026/uniform_mean_768, paired over the same studies, folds and study resamples, via scripts/analysis/compare_downstream_arms.py
comparisons.confounded: projection_256 is a learned 768->256 linear-plus-GELU compression; a linear probe cannot gain from compression, so this arm is reported but is not evidence against contrastive learning
comparisons.primary: before_cl/uniform_mean_768 versus each after_cl arm's uniform_mean_768 -- matched pooling and dimensionality, so the only difference is the adapted DINOv2 block

config.estimand: Readout quality of a frozen representation on a cohort it was trained on. Explicitly NOT generalisation: 56 of 58 gold cases were exposed to contrastive training or checkpoint selection.

metrics.environment_note: sklearn 1.8 deprecates the explicit penalty=l2 argument pinned above and removes it in 1.10. The fitted model is unchanged, since l2 is the default; a rerun on 1.10 must translate it to l1_ratio=0 rather than silently dropping it.
metrics.primary: pooled out-of-fold AUROC per label, macro-averaged over the 12 labels
metrics.rare_labels: MCL has 8 positives over 56 cases: pooled-OOF only, fold-level AUROC declared uninformative in advance
metrics.tie_policy: midrank. Every reported point estimate comes from sklearn.metrics.roc_auc_score. The bootstrap replicates use an equivalent rank-sum implementation (scipy.stats.rankdata) for speed, and the script asserts the two agree to 1e-9 on every label's real scores before building any interval. Section 6 of the EDA notebook's argsort AUROC is reported alongside the LM reference for comparison only, never used as a result.

config.population: gold studies whose cohort split is train or validation; locked-test gold studies are counted only

probe.fold: StratifiedKFold(shuffle=True), stratification computed inside the per-label fold loop
probe.predictions: exactly one held-out decision_function score per study per label
probe.standardize: StandardScaler fitted inside each training fold
probe.tuning: none; every hyperparameter is fixed here before the first fit

config.purpose: Every image-block variant plus the shuffled-pairing control, scored in one extraction pass so all arms share identical folds and resamples.

reference.lm_label_extraction: data/lm_label/*.csv scored against the same gold labels on the same 56 studies, as the text-side label-extraction ceiling

config.scope: Read-only over existing artifacts. No training, no locked-test evaluation, no writes into any run directory.
